title: Reference article frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for the docs corpus under `<platform>/reference/<slug>.md`, written by `pnpm refresh:docs`.

feature.description: Routing tag — matches a feature bucket the agent can ask about.

archetype.description: Article archetype tag (integration / feature / identity), carried through from pipeline config.

sdk_min_version.description: Semver pin: the SDK release every snippet in the file was validated against.

sdk_artifact.description: Maven / Cocoapods / npm artifact name. Android: `iterableapi`. React Native: `@iterable/react-native-sdk`.

summary.description: Agent-facing 2-3 sentence summary, extracted from the first prose paragraph(s). Required.

source_url.description: Public-facing URL where humans can read the same content.

source_repo.description: GitHub owner/repo of the upstream docs source.

source_ref.description: Docs-repo commit this file was last fetched at. Files skipped as unchanged keep their earlier ref, so the corpus can hold a mix; pipeline/config `source.ref` is the latest refresh point.

source_sha.description: Git blob SHA of the source file. Compared on refresh to decide whether to rewrite.

fetched_at.description: When this file was last rewritten. Unchanged files keep their previous value, so a no-op refresh produces no diff.

android_excerpt.description: Optional. Marks a doc sourced from a cross-platform article that still contains foreign-platform (iOS/web) examples. Informational - the transform does not strip foreign code.
